name: DS Cluster S13: Session Windows (RTH, custom, IB)
description: Tests: session_window with EquityRTHSession and custom session. Outputs: .open .high .low .close .opened .closed.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S13: Session Windows
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === RTH SESSION ===
rth = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
rth_range = rth.high - rth.low

# === INITIAL BALANCE (first 30 min) ===
ib = session_window(session=Session(start="09:30", end="10:00", tz="America/New_York"))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
ib_high = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.high))
ib_low = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.low))

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="RTH Range",
    category="Sessions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Range", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rth_range)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="IB High", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="IB Closed"
    )
)(ib_high, ib.closed)
